title: The Boat of Cushions
youtube_title: The Boat of Cushions | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a cushion boat that sank unless the sides were tucked together will go wrong if one person rushes. Bodhi and Lale split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
